title: Flow Rate
tagline: A unique Lending & Borrowing Protocol enabled by Flow's Resource model
description: In Flow Rate, the liquidity positions of each user is managed with the help of liquidity Buckets. Each bucket is an isolated liquidity position and liquidation of one doesn't affect other. This allows for far greater flexibility in how you lend & borrow capital and also how much risk you want to take on different set of tokens. Each bucket in itself is also a resource which allows for the possibility of a never seen before liquidity bucket market. Buckets can be freely traded without risk to the protocol itself or to the users.
how_its_made: This uses Cadence for contracts and Next.js for frontend. FlowRate.cdc handles all the main contract logic.
